pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to quit' && sleep 2 && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to try
try
delete (first folder whose name is "Personal Ideas")
on error
end try
try
delete (first folder whose name is "Meeting Notes")
on error
end try
try
delete (first folder whose name is "Work Projects")
on error
end try
try
delete (first note whose name is "Project A Plan")
on error
end try
try
delete (first note whose name is "Budget Review")
on error
end try
try
delete (first note whose name is "Team Schedule")
on error
end try
try
delete (first note whose name is "Shopping List")
on error
end try
try
delete (first note whose name is "Vacation Ideas")
on error
end try
set personalFolder to make new folder with properties {name:"Personal Ideas"}
set meetingFolder to make new folder with properties {name:"Meeting Notes"}
set projectNote to make new note with properties {name:"Project A Plan", body:"Project A timeline and milestones\n- Phase 1: Research\n- Phase 2: Development\n- Phase 3: Testing"}
set budgetNote to make new note with properties {name:"Budget Review", body:"Q3 Budget Analysis\n\nRevenue: $150K\nExpenses: $120K\nProfit: $30K"}
set scheduleNote to make new note with properties {name:"Team Schedule", body:"Weekly team meetings\nMonday 9 AM - Standup\nWednesday 2 PM - Planning\nFriday 4 PM - Retrospective"}
set shoppingNote to make new note with properties {name:"Shopping List", body:"Groceries needed:\n- Milk\n- Bread\n- Eggs\n- Apples\n- Chicken"}
set vacationNote to make new note with properties {name:"Vacation Ideas", body:"Potential destinations:\n- Hawaii\n- Europe tour\n- Mountain camping\n- Beach resort"}
move scheduleNote to meetingFolder
move shoppingNote to personalFolder
move vacationNote to personalFolder
return true
on error
return false
end try'
instruction: Organize existing notes by creating a new folder called 'Work Projects' and move notes titled 'Project A Plan' and 'Budget Review' into this folder.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to try
set folderExists to false
set projectNoteInFolder to false
set budgetNoteInFolder to false
try
set workFolder to first folder whose name is "Work Projects"
set folderExists to true
set notesInFolder to notes of workFolder
repeat with aNote in notesInFolder
set noteName to name of aNote
if noteName is "Project A Plan" then
set projectNoteInFolder to true
end if
if noteName is "Budget Review" then
set budgetNoteInFolder to true
end if
end repeat
on error
set folderExists to false
end try
return (folderExists and projectNoteInFolder and budgetNoteInFolder)
on error
return false
end try'
